name: mediahub
description: Dashboard for Sonarr, Radarr, qBittorrent, Seerr, Plex, Unraid and more: requests, library bulk edit, alerts, music and books, subtitles, Usenet, health checks, status pages and profiles with two-step sign-in. Try it first with the DEMO variable.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Accounts, saved apps and the encryption key. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: Port for the MediaHub web page

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the data folder (99 is nobody on Unraid)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the data folder (100 is users on Unraid)

variables.name: Setup code
variables.description: Optional. If set, creating the first admin asks for this code.

variables.name: Trust proxy
variables.description: Set to true only if MediaHub is behind a reverse proxy or tunnel you control.
